title: Check a carved terrain space by reading the terrain, not the script
observation: A volcano's crater was meant to be hollowed by a stack of air fills 2.2 studs thick. In a Studio test an air fill thinner than one 4-stud terrain cell removed nothing, so the summit was solid and the treasure inside it unreachable from the first version that had it. A raycast through the crater centre hit the summit; a thick air block cleared it.
recommendation: Make carving fills at least one terrain cell (4 studs) thick, then verify the result by reading voxels or raycasting through the space before calling it reachable. A path-finding query from the approach to the objective is a quick follow-up, not a substitute for walking it.
applies_when: A treasure or route sits inside a carved cave, crater or tunnel
limits: Observed in one Studio build with Terrain:FillCylinder; other fill shapes were not compared
The measured threshold is this game's observation, not an engine specification

evidence.detail: Section 18 records the crater centre reading 129.8 before the fix and 113.1 after, and a path from the beach reaching the crown.
